newsitem.title: FINLAND: PONSSE STARTS FIM 10 MLN INVESTMENT AT ONCE.
newsitem.headline: PONSSE STARTS FIM 10 MLN INVESTMENT AT ONCE.

text.p: Finnish forest machine maker Ponsse Oy said in a statement on Monday it would start an investment to expand production facilities at once, a year ahead of its preliminary plan, to meet increasing demand.
"The cost estimate for the investment is 10 million markka and is intended to be covered with cash flow," Ponsse said.
A new painting line would be built at the production plant and the space for welding would be expanded, it said.
The expansion would cover an area of 2,500 square metres.
"Since the end of the financial year, demand for Ponsse's new forest machine models has been strong," the company said.
"The purpose of bringing forward the investment is to meet strongly increased demand," it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
